units.source_text: 根据夫人的讲述，我猜想，K似乎以最沉静的震惊承受了这最后的打击。

en.t: From what the mistress told me, I imagined that K had borne this final blow with the calmest kind of shock.

units.source_text: 当K知道我和小姐之间结成的新关系时，最初说了句，‘是吗？’

en.t: When K learned of the new relationship that had been formed between the young lady and me, at first he merely said, "Is that so?"

units.source_text: 但是当夫人说‘你也为我们高兴高兴啊’的时候，他才望着夫人的脸，露出微笑，说：‘恭喜您了。’

en.t: But when the mistress said, "You should be happy for us too," he finally looked at her face, smiled, and said, "Congratulations."
After saying that, he stood up.

units.source_text: 在打开茶室的隔扇门之前，他又回过头来问夫人：‘他们什么时候结婚？’

en.t: Before opening the sliding door to the tea room, he turned back again and asked the mistress, "When will they marry?"

units.source_text: 然后又道：‘我本想送些贺礼，可是没有钱，只好作罢了。’

en.t: Then he added, "I had wanted to send some wedding gift, but I have no money, so I must give up the idea."

units.source_text: 我坐在夫人面前，听了这番话，觉得胸口发闷，非常难受。

en.t: Sitting in front of the mistress and hearing those words, I felt a tightness in my chest and was deeply distressed.
